## Load data

Read in standard lengths

```{r}
lengths <- read.csv("Data/stlength-harem.csv") %>%
  filter(Species %in% c("Sctaeniopterus", "Spaurofrenatum") & Phase == "TP") %>%
  # Sc taeniopterus - used male Sc taeniopterus fishbase - TL = 0 + 1.176*SL
  # Sp aurofrenatum - used male Sp viride fishbase - SL = 0 + 0.796*TL
  mutate(TL = ifelse(Species == "Sctaeniopterus", SL*1.176, SL/0.796),
  # Sc taeniopterus - used mixed Sc taeniopterus fishbase - FL = 0.968 + 1.160*SL
  # Sp aurofrenatum - used male Sp viride fishbase - FL = 0 + 0.894*TL
         FL = ifelse(Species == "Sctaeniopterus", (SL*1.160)+0.968, 0.894*TL)) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(mSL = mean(SL),
            seSL = sd(SL)/sqrt(n()),
            mTotal_len = mean(TL), 
            seTotal_len = sd(TL)/sqrt(n()),
            mFL = mean(FL),
            seFL = sd(FL)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup()
```


Read in parasite data

```{r}
parasites <- read.csv("Data/parasites_total.csv") %>%
  separate(File.Name, c("Site", "Species", "Phase", "Date", "EndTime", "Vid"), sep = "_") %>%
  rename(BS1 = BS_Reviewer.1,
         BS2 = BS_Reviewer.2,
         WS1 = WS_Reviewer.1,
         WS2 = WS_Reviewer.2,
         BSr = Double_count_remove_BS) %>%
  select(-Body.Part) %>%
  # there were a few instances where two videos were used to count parasites. remove second video for now.
  group_by(Site, Species, Phase, Date, EndTime) %>%  # group by trial identifiers
  summarise(across(c(BS1:BSr), ~ round(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))),  # take mean of numeric columns
            Vid = paste(unique(Vid), collapse = ", ")) %>%  # optional: keep a record of which VIDs were combined
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-Vid) %>%
  # fill na with 0 for BSr
  mutate(BSr = replace_na(BSr, 0),
         BS1c = BS1-BSr,
         BS2c = BS2-BSr) %>%
  select(-c(BS1, BS2, BSr)) %>%
  # compute Total_load
  mutate(BS = round((BS1c+BS2c)/2, 0),
         WS = round((WS1+WS2)/2, 0),
         Total_load = BS + WS)
```


Read in home range/core use sizes and contours for mapping

```{r eval = F}
hr.size <- read.csv("ProcessedData/Full_HRs.csv")

AQ95 <- st_read("ProcessedData/aq2021.mkde95.shp")

IV95 <- st_read("ProcessedData/iv2021.mkde95.shp")

# Determine centroids of home ranges for mapping infection
AQcent <- st_centroid(AQ95)
IVcent <- st_centroid(IV95)
```


Read in behavioral observation annotations.

```{r eval = F}
bhav <- read.csv("Data/behave2021_updated.csv")

# Calculate observation times
follow.start <- bhav %>%
  filter(Behavior == "START/STOP") %>%
  filter(Status == "START") %>%
  rename(Start = "Time") %>%
  select(ID, Start)
n_distinct(follow.start) #86

follow.stop <- bhav %>%
  filter(Behavior == "START/STOP") %>%
  filter(Status == "STOP") %>%
  rename(Stop = "Time") %>%
  select(ID, Stop)
n_distinct(follow.stop) #86

follow.time <- left_join(follow.stop, follow.start) %>%
  mutate(Follow.Time = (Stop - Start)/60) %>%
  select(ID, Follow.Time) %>%
  separate(ID, c("Site", "Species", "Phase", "Date", "EndTime"), sep = "_")


# Format behavioral data - create time stamps for each behavior

# Start by creating a new data frame with the start times (time on watch in video) for each video observation
starts <- bhav %>%
  filter(Behavior == "Watch Time") %>%
  select(ID, Time, Modifier.1) %>%
  rename(WatchTime = Time, 
         Watch = Modifier.1)

starts$Watch <- as.POSIXct(starts$Watch, format="%H%M%S")
starts$Watch <- format(starts$Watch, "%H:%M:%S")

library(chron)

beh.fin <- plyr::join(bhav, starts, by = "ID") %>%
  separate(ID, c("Site", "Species", "Phase", "Date", "EndTime"), sep = "_", remove = F) %>%
  select(-Media.file.path, -Total.length, -FPS, -Subject, -Behavioral.category, -Comment)

beh.fin$Time <- times(beh.fin$Time / (24 * 60 * 60))
beh.fin$WatchTime <- times(beh.fin$WatchTime / (24 * 60 * 60))

beh.fin$ActualTime <- beh.fin$Watch + (beh.fin$Time - beh.fin$WatchTime)
```


Next, combine the date and actual time columns and make it POSIXct

```{r eval = F}
beh.fin$Date <- as.Date(beh.fin$Date)

beh.fin <- beh.fin %>% unite("time", c("Date", "ActualTime"), sep = " ", remove = F)

beh.fin$time <- as.POSIXct(strptime(as.character(beh.fin$time), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))

#Convert the actual times to UTC by adding 4 hours (EST is UTC-4 in spring/summer)
beh.fin$time <- beh.fin$time + lubridate::hours(4)

behavior <- beh.fin %>%
  select(-Site, -Species, -Phase, -Date, -EndTime, -Watch, -WatchTime)
```


Compute bite rates and get cleaning time

```{r eval = F}
bites <- behavior %>%
  filter(Behavior == "Bite" & Modifier.1 != "Feces") %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(N_bites = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  separate(ID, c("Site", "Species", "Phase", "Date", "EndTime"), sep = "_")

conflicts_prefer(dplyr::arrange)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::lag)

cleaning <- behavior %>%
  filter(Behavior == "Cleaning") %>%
  arrange(ID, time) %>%
  mutate(Duration = time - lag(time)) %>%
  filter(Status == "STOP") %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(N_clean = n(),
            Dur_clean = as.numeric(sum(Duration))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  separate(ID, c("Site", "Species", "Phase", "Date", "EndTime"), sep = "_")

interact <- behavior %>%
  filter(Behavior == "Parrotfish") %>%
  arrange(ID, time) %>%
  mutate(Duration = time - lag(time)) %>%
  filter(Status == "STOP") %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(N_int = n(), 
            Dur_int = as.numeric(sum(Duration))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  separate(ID, c("Site", "Species", "Phase", "Date", "EndTime"), sep = "_")

interact2 <- behavior %>%
  filter(Behavior == "Parrotfish" & Modifier.1 == "Conspecific" & Modifier.3 == "TP") %>%
  arrange(ID, time) %>%
  mutate(Duration = time - lag(time)) %>%
  filter(Status == "STOP") %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(N_Cint = n(), 
            Dur_Cint = as.numeric(sum(Duration))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  separate(ID, c("Site", "Species", "Phase", "Date", "EndTime"), sep = "_")
```


Merge behavioral and spatial data with parasite loads

```{r eval = F}
centroids <- rbind(AQcent, IVcent) %>% select(-ID)

final.parasites <- centroids %>%
  left_join(bites) %>%
  left_join(cleaning) %>%
  left_join(interact) %>%
  left_join(interact2) %>%
  left_join(parasites) %>%
  left_join(follow.time) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Total_load)) %>%
  mutate(N_clean = ifelse(is.na(N_clean), 0, N_clean),
         Dur_clean = ifelse(is.na(Dur_clean), 0, Dur_clean),
         N_Cint = ifelse(is.na(N_Cint), 0, N_Cint),
         Dur_Cint = ifelse(is.na(Dur_Cint), 0, Dur_Cint),
         Prob_Cint = ifelse(N_Cint == 0, "0", "1"))

st_write(final.parasites, "ProcessedData/final.parasites.gpkg", driver = "GPKG", append = F) # Save as a shapefile
```

First, a correlation analysis to determine how close observers were in their estimates of parasite load

```{r}

parasites.sc <- final.parasites %>% filter(Species == "Sctaeniopterus") %>%
  mutate(TL1 = WS1 + BS1c,
         TL2 = WS2 + BS2c)

cor.test(parasites.sc$BS1c, parasites.sc$BS2c,
  method = "pearson")
#r = 0.71 p < 0.001

cor.test(parasites.sc$WS1, parasites.sc$WS2,
```

## Analyze link between BSS infection and behavior:

Bites

```{r}
# Bites
bite.para.m1 <- glmmTMB(data = final.parasites, 
                       N_bites ~ Site*Species + Site*logTL + Species*logTL +
                         offset(log(Follow.Time)), family = nbinom2())

test.bite.para <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = bite.para.m1, n = 250, plot = T)
summary(bite.para.m1)

# Interaction terms involving total load are not significant, so remove

bite.para.m2 <- glmmTMB(data = final.parasites, 
                       N_bites ~ Site*Species + logTL +
                         offset(log(Follow.Time)), family = nbinom2())

test.bite.para <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = bite.para.m2, n = 250, plot = T)

summary(bite.para.m2)
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
Anova(bite.para.m2, type = 3)

# per unit increase in ln(severity+1), x% change in rate

(exp(-0.09482) - 1)*100

# McFadden's R2 and p-value

null.bite.m2 <- update(bite.para.m2, . ~ 1)

ll.full.bite <- logLik(bite.para.m2)
ll.null.bite <- logLik(null.bite.m2)

mcf.r2.bite <- as.numeric(1 - (ll.full.bite / ll.null.bite))
mcf.r2.bite

lr.bite <- as.numeric(2* (ll.full.bite - ll.null.bite))

df.full.bite <- attr(ll.full.bite, "df")
df.null.bite <- attr(ll.null.bite, "df")
df.diff.bite <- df.full.bite - df.null.bite

mcf.pval.bite <- pchisq(lr.bite, df = df.diff.bite, lower.tail = FALSE)
mcf.pval.bite


# Visualize effect of BSS severity on bite rate

# Create data frame

new.bites <- final.parasites %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(logTL = list(seq(min(logTL, na.rm = TRUE),
                             max(logTL, na.rm = TRUE),
                             length.out = 100)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  unnest(logTL) %>%
  mutate(Site = "AQ",
         Follow.Time = median(final.parasites$Follow.Time))

# Predict from the model

preds <- predict(
  bite.para.m2,
  newdata = new.bites,
  type = "link",
  se.fit = TRUE)

new.bites$fit <- exp(preds$fit)
new.bites$lower <- exp(preds$fit - 1.96 * preds$se.fit)
new.bites$upper <- exp(preds$fit + 1.96 * preds$se.fit)
new.bites$eta <- preds$fit
new.bites$se <- preds$se.fit

# Plot

bites.p <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = final.parasites, aes(x = logTL, y = N_bites, color = Species), 
             size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
```

```{r}
# Parrotfish interactions

ic.para.m1 <- glmmTMB(data = final.parasites, 
                      N_Cint ~ Site*Species + Site*logTL + Species*logTL + 
                        offset(log(Follow.Time)), family = nbinom2())

test.ic.para <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = ic.para.m1, n = 250, plot = T)
summary(ic.para.m1)

# No significant interaction with total load for either of the categorical main effects, so remove

ic.para.m2 <- glmmTMB(data = final.parasites, 
                      N_Cint ~ Site*Species + logTL + 
                        offset(log(Follow.Time)), family = nbinom2())

test.ic.para2 <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = ic.para.m2, n = 250, plot = T)

summary(ic.para.m2)
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
Anova(ic.para.m2, type = 3)

# per unit increase in ln(severity+1), x% change in rate
(exp(0.2205) - 1)*100

# McFadden's R2 and p-value
null.ic.m2 <- update(ic.para.m2, . ~ 1)

ll.full.ic <- logLik(ic.para.m2)
ll.null.ic <- logLik(null.ic.m2)

mcf.r2.ic <- as.numeric(1 - (ll.full.ic / ll.null.ic))
mcf.r2.ic

lr.ic <- as.numeric(2* (ll.full.ic - ll.null.ic))

df.full.ic <- attr(ll.full.ic, "df")
df.null.ic <- attr(ll.null.ic, "df")
df.diff.ic <- df.full.ic - df.null.ic

mcf.pval.ic <- pchisq(lr.ic, df = df.diff.ic, lower.tail = FALSE)
mcf.pval.ic
```

Foraging area

```{r}
# Size of foraging areas

hr.para.m1 <- glmmTMB(data = final.parasites, area ~ Site*Species + Site*logTL + Species*logTL + 
                        Species*scale(Follow.Time), family = "gaussian")
test.hr.para <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = hr.para.m1, n = 250, plot = T)
summary(hr.para.m1)
model.matrix(hr.para.m1) # determine indexing

# Conditional slopes for species
-2.2237 + 13.7027 # Sc. taeniopterus
-2.2237 - 13.7027 # Sp. aurofrenatum

# Compute adj-R2 

# Extract the actual response variable values from the model

y <- final.parasites$area

# Extract residuals from model and get number of observations and coefficients

resids <- residuals(hr.para.m1) # Pull residuals from model
n <- length(resids) # Number of observations
p <- length(fixef(hr.para.m1)$cond) # Number of coefficients (including intercept)

# Calculate adj-R2

rss <- sum(resids^2) # Residual SS
tss <- sum((y - mean(y))^2) # Total SS
r2 <- 1 - (rss / tss) # R2

adj.r2 <- 1 - ((1 - r2) * (n - 1) / (n - p)) # adjusted R2
print(adj.r2)
```

## Assess population-level changes in bite rates for our observed populations and a population with no infection.

```{r}
lesions <- final.parasites %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(Species == "Sctaeniopterus") %>%
  pull(as.numeric(Total_load)) %>%
  unname()

# Estimated slope from negative binomial GLM
beta <- -0.09482

# Predicted bite rate of uninfected fish per 20 min
bite_uninfected <- new.bites %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(Species == "Sctaeniopterus" & logTL == 0) %>% 
  mutate(fit = as.numeric(round(fit, 0))) %>%
  pull(fit) %>%
  unname()

# Individual predictions
population <- tibble(
 fish_id = seq_along(lesions),
 lesions = lesions) %>%
 mutate(relative_bite_rate = (lesions + 1)^beta,
        predicted_bites = bite_uninfected * relative_bite_rate,
        percent_reduction = 100 * (1 - relative_bite_rate))

# Population summary
population_summary <- population %>% 
  summarise(n_fish = n(),
            prevalence = mean(lesions > 0),
            mean_lesions = mean(lesions),
            sd_lesions = sd(lesions),
            mean_predicted_bites = mean(predicted_bites),
            sd_predicted_bites = sd(predicted_bites),
            relative_grazing = mean(relative_bite_rate),
            percent_reduction = 100 * (1 - relative_grazing))

print(population_summary)
```


## Investigating relationship between BSS infection and per area grazing CaCO3 removed

# Continuous version
```{r eval = F}
library(purrr)

set.seed(123)
nsim <- 1000

bites.grps <- final.parasites %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(Total_load = list(seq(min(Total_load, na.rm = T),
                                  max(Total_load, na.rm = T),
                                  by = 1L)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  unnest(Total_load) %>%
  mutate(Site = "AQ",
         Follow.Time = median(final.parasites$Follow.Time, na.rm = T),
         logTL = log(Total_load + 1))

preds.sim <- predict(bite.para.m2, newdata = bites.grps,
                     type = "link", se.fit = T)

bites.grps$eta <- preds.sim$fit
bites.grps$se  <- preds.sim$se.fit


# Monte Carlo simulations to simulate area and volume removed per bite 1000 times for each BSS severity

sim.results <- map(seq_len(nsim), function(i) {

  # Re-draw area and volume removed slopes each iteration
  # Bruggemann et al. 1996 using Sc. vetula equations for both
  area.slope <- rnorm(1, 4.013, 0.241)
  vol.slope  <- rnorm(1, 0.193, 0.020)

  bites.grps %>%
    mutate(iter = i,
           sim_eta = rnorm(n(), eta, se),   # bite rate noise per row
           bites_20min = exp(sim_eta),
           vol_slope = vol.slope,
           area_slope = area.slope)
}) %>%
  list_rbind()


# Join area grazed and erosion data with everything else and compute metrics

erosion.params <- lengths %>%
  select(Species, mFL) %>%
  # Adam et al. 2018
  mutate(prop_bite_scars = ifelse(Species == "Sctaeniopterus", 0.27,  0.06),
  # Caribbean average from ReefBudget methodology June 2024
         substrate_dens  = 1.72,
  # Bellwood et al. 1995
         prop_day_feed   = ifelse(Species == "Sctaeniopterus", 0.877, 0.833))

sim.erosion <- sim.results %>%
  left_join(erosion.params, by = "Species") %>%
  mutate(cm3_per_bite = vol_slope  * (10^-6) * (mFL^3),
         cm2_per_bite = area_slope * (10^-4) * (mFL^2),
         bites_min = bites_20min / 20,
         bites_wscar_min = bites_min * prop_bite_scars,
         cm2_day  = bites_wscar_min * cm2_per_bite * 60 * 12 * prop_day_feed,
         cm3_day  = bites_wscar_min * cm3_per_bite * 60 * 12 * prop_day_feed,
         kg_day   = (cm3_day * substrate_dens) / 1000,
         m2_year  = (cm2_day * 365) / 10000,
         kg_year  = kg_day * 365,
         Total_load = round(exp(logTL)-1))


sct.erosion <- sim.erosion %>% filter(Species == "Sctaeniopterus")

area.m1 <- glmmTMB(log(m2_year) ~ logTL, family = gaussian(),
                   data = sct.erosion)
test.area <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = area.m1, n = 250, plot = T)
summary(area.m1)


erosion.m1 <- glmmTMB(log(kg_year) ~ logTL, family = gaussian(),
                   data = sct.erosion)
test.erosion <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = erosion.m1, n = 250, plot = T)
summary(erosion.m1)


# Summarise

erosion.summary <- sim.erosion %>%
  group_by(Species, logTL, Total_load, severity) %>%
  summarise(across(c(bites_20min, kg_year, m2_year),
                   list(mean = mean,
                        lo95   = ~ quantile(.x, 0.025),
                        hi95   = ~ quantile(.x, 0.975)),
                   .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
            .groups = "drop")

# Plot

area.grazed.p <- ggplot(data = erosion.summary %>% filter(Species == "Sctaeniopterus"), 
       aes(x = severity, y = m2_year_mean)) +
  geom_point(stat = "identity", color = sct.color, size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = severity, ymin = m2_year_lo95, ymax = m2_year_hi95), 
                color = sct.color, width = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "BSS Severity", y = expression("Area Cleared (m"^2~"ind"^-1~"y"^-1~")")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())
area.grazed.p

mass.removed.p <- ggplot(data = erosion.summary %>% filter(Species == "Sctaeniopterus"), 
       aes(x = severity, y = kg_year_mean)) +
  geom_point(stat = "identity", color = sct.color, size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = severity, ymin = kg_year_lo95, ymax = kg_year_hi95), 
                color = sct.color, width = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "BSS Severity", y = expression("Bioerosion (kg CaCO"[3]~"ind"^-1~"y"^-1~")")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())
mass.removed.p

erosion.p <- ggarrange(area.grazed.p, mass.removed.p, ncol = 2, nrow = 1, labels = c("a", "b"), 
                       font.label = list(size = 10, color = "black"))
erosion.p

ggsave("Figures/Parasites/erosion.png", plot = erosion.p,
       width = 6.5, height = 3, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
  select(Species, mFL) %>%
  mutate(prop_bite_scars = ifelse(Species == "Sctaeniopterus", 0.27,  0.06),
         substrate_dens  = 1.72,
         prop_day_feed   = ifelse(Species == "Sctaeniopterus", 0.877, 0.833))

sim.erosion <- sim.results %>%
  left_join(erosion.params, by = "Species") %>%
  mutate(cm3_per_bite = vol_slope  * (10^-6) * (mFL^3),
         cm2_per_bite = area_slope * (10^-4) * (mFL^2),
         bites_min = bites_20min / 20,
         bites_wscar_min = bites_min * prop_bite_scars,
         cm2_day  = bites_wscar_min * cm2_per_bite * 60 * 12 * prop_day_feed,
         cm3_day  = bites_wscar_min * cm3_per_bite * 60 * 12 * prop_day_feed,
         kg_day   = (cm3_day * substrate_dens) / 1000,
         m2_year  = (cm2_day * 365) / 10000,
         kg_year  = kg_day * 365,
         Total_load = round(exp(logTL)-1),
         severity = ifelse(Total_load <= 2, "Min", ifelse(Total_load >= 54, "Max", "Median"))) %>%
  mutate(severity = factor(severity, levels = c("Min", "Median", "Max")))


sct.erosion <- sim.erosion %>% filter(Species == "Sctaeniopterus")


# library(rstatix)
# kruskal.test(m2_year ~ severity, data = sct.erosion)
# dunn_test(m2_year ~ severity, data = sct.erosion)
# 
# kruskal.test(kg_year ~ severity, data = sct.erosion)
# dunn_test(kg_year ~ severity, data = sct.erosion)


# Summarise

erosion.summary <- sim.erosion %>%
  group_by(Species, logTL, Total_load, severity) %>%
  summarise(across(c(bites_20min, kg_year, m2_year),
                   list(mean = mean,
                        lo95   = ~ quantile(.x, 0.025),
                        hi95   = ~ quantile(.x, 0.975)),
                   .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
            .groups = "drop")

# Plot

area.grazed.p <- ggplot(data = erosion.summary %>% filter(Species == "Sctaeniopterus"), 
       aes(x = severity, y = m2_year_mean)) +
  geom_point(stat = "identity", color = sct.color, size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = severity, ymin = m2_year_lo95, ymax = m2_year_hi95), 
                color = sct.color, width = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "BSS Severity", y = expression("Area Cleared (m"^2~"ind"^-1~"y"^-1~")")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 8), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 10)) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank()) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("None", "Low", "High"))
area.grazed.p

mass.removed.p <- ggplot(data = erosion.summary %>% filter(Species == "Sctaeniopterus"), 
       aes(x = severity, y = kg_year_mean)) +
  geom_point(stat = "identity", color = sct.color, size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = severity, ymin = kg_year_lo95, ymax = kg_year_hi95), 
                color = sct.color, width = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "BSS Severity", y = expression("Bioerosion (kg CaCO"[3]~"ind"^-1~"y"^-1~")")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 8), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 10)) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank()) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("None", "Low", "High"))
mass.removed.p

erosion.p <- ggarrange(area.grazed.p, mass.removed.p, ncol = 2, nrow = 1, labels = c("a", "b"), 
                       font.label = list(size = 10, color = "black"))
erosion.p

ggsave("Figures/Parasites/erosion.png", plot = erosion.p,
       width = 6.5, height = 3, dpi = 300)
```
